title: Basic FFT MicroSim
description: A basic demonstration of FFT with time domain visualization on the top and frequency domain on the bottom, featuring adjustable frequency and amplitude controls.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Signal Processing
FFT
Fourier Transform
Frequency Analysis
learningObjectives: Explain that the FFT decomposes a time-domain waveform into the frequencies it contains
Predict that raising the frequency slider shortens the wavelength in the top time-domain plot and shifts the spectral peak rightward in the bottom frequency-domain plot
Predict how increasing the amplitude slider raises the waveform's height and the height of its spectral peak while leaving the peak's frequency unchanged
Distinguish the time-domain display, which plots amplitude against time, from the frequency-domain display, which plots magnitude against frequency
Identify the frequency of a pure sine wave by reading the location of its single spectral peak
